links.outcome: LLM accuracy drop from standard MCQA to harder benchmark on Polish medical exams
links.effect: Best model (Qwen3.5-122B) drops 28.4 pp on English and 31 pp on Polish exams under the harder setup; standard MCQA scores do not reliably reflect true medical competence.
links.quote: Under our harder setup, the best model (Qwen3.5-122B) drops by 28.4 and 31 pp on English and Polish exams, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Modifying multiple-choice benchmark structure to reduce guessing and answer-bias artifacts
Assessing data contamination of medical exam benchmarks

screen.reason: Evaluates 21 LLMs on an expanded Polish medical exam benchmark to study MCQA artifacts and test robustness, which is an automated benchmark study without testing a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
